description: Move forward (or back, with negative days) a number of South Korean business days from a start date, skipping weekends and public holidays. The start date itself is not counted. Use for deadlines like "within 7 business days". Holiday data covers 2024-2027 (source: KASI; updated 2026-11-12). It includes substitute holidays and election days, and the 2026 additions Labor Day (May 1) and Constitution Day (Jul 17).

days.description: Business days to add; negative goes back.

extra_closed_dates.description: Optional extra non-working dates (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. company holidays.

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today in Korea (KST).

name: kr_add_business_days
title: Add Korean business days
